info.title: SERK QUORUM API
info.description: Session cookie authentication. State-changing requests require the `x-csrf-token` header from GET /auth/session. Every response carries `x-request-id`. Breaking changes require a new major path (/api/v2).

post.summary: Create an account and first organization (if enabled)
Sign in; sets the HttpOnly session cookie
Revoke all sessions of the current user

get.summary: Current user, memberships and CSRF token

post.summary: Create an invitation; returns the single-use token once
Accept an invitation addressed to the caller's email
Save a new version (optimistic concurrency via base_version)
Change status; approve/reject/supersede need decisions_decide and confirm=true
One text completion (fixture or live with explicit consent)
